items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I played him and Henry Red Island.

ctx.x: 26 now. Then another wonderful drummer used to play with Celestine. His name was Happy. I used to enjoy him. He was a good drummer too. Is that Red Happy?

Do you remember which Happy? Or is it Happy Gold? I think it's Happy Gold. The last one I was working on here at Paddock. Oh yeah. That's Happy Gold. He plays in Eureka. That's in Eureka. I played him and Henry Red Island.

That was my trumpet player. I used to love to hear him play trumpet. Him and Chris Kelly and Buddy P.T. Those who were trumpet players I used to get on the truck. When they would be playing on the truck I would hop on the truck and ride around. Listen to them. They didn't mind you getting on the truck? They didn't mind me getting on the truck because I used to be so little I could hand the handbills around. Oh yeah. They would get me all full of them.
